channel.name: Sandeep Swadia
channel.blurb: From homeless teen to monk to MIT grad to CEO. Distilling AI, mental models, communication, money and clear thinking for high performers.

note: Concept summaries and value ratings are AI-generated digests to help you find the right video fast — not transcripts. View counts are as of the last refresh.

videos.title: How To Learn So Fast It's Almost Unfair
videos.summary: A meta-learning system for acquiring skills at unfair speed. Core moves: active recall over passive review, tight feedback loops, and using AI as a tutor that explains, quizzes, and pressure-tests your understanding until it sticks.
videos.takeaway: Speed of learning is the ultimate competitive edge — engineer feedback loops, don't just consume.

videos.title: You're Not Behind (Yet): How to Learn AI in 17 Minutes
videos.summary: A 7-step roadmap to go from AI novice to confident user in ~30 days. Introduces the AIM prompting framework — Actor (give the AI a role), Input (feed it context and data), Mission (state the exact output you want).
videos.takeaway: Use AIM — Actor, Input, Mission — to turn vague prompts into sharp results.

videos.title: Give Me 18 Minutes and I'll Make You Dangerously Smart (with AI)
videos.summary: A fast system for compounding intelligence with AI: compress research, stress-test your ideas against a critic, and build durable mental frameworks in minutes instead of months.
videos.takeaway: Intelligence is now a workflow you can design — let AI be your sparring partner.

videos.title: You're Not Behind (Yet): Learn AI Agents in 13 Minutes
videos.summary: A primer on AI agents: what they are, how they chain reasoning with tools to take actions, and how to start using and building them before the curve leaves you behind.
videos.takeaway: Agents turn AI from giving answers into taking actions.

videos.title: How To Manage Your Time Like a CEO
videos.summary: CEO-grade time management: ruthless prioritization, protecting deep work, delegating maintenance, and spending your best hours on leverage rather than busywork.
videos.takeaway: Manage energy and priorities, not just your calendar.

videos.title: How To Speak Like A Billion-Dollar CEO
videos.summary: The speaking patterns of top executives: concise framing, leading with the conclusion, pausing for weight, and projecting calm authority instead of filling silence.
videos.takeaway: Speak less, mean more, lead with the point.

videos.title: How To Use Claude Better Than 99% Of People
videos.summary: Practical techniques for elite results from Claude: role-based prompting, giving rich context up front, iterating like a back-and-forth session, and structuring the output you ask for.
videos.takeaway: Great prompting = direction + context + iteration.

videos.title: How To Become Dangerously Self-Educated (with AI)
videos.summary: A blueprint for using AI as a personal tutor to self-educate faster than any traditional path: build a loop where AI explains, quizzes and challenges you, pick high-leverage skills, and compound curiosity into a real knowledge system.
videos.takeaway: Treat AI as a Socratic tutor, not an answer machine.

videos.title: How To Think SO CLEARLY People Assume You're A Genius
videos.summary: Why smart people still make expensive thinking mistakes, and the mental models that produce clear, first-principles reasoning. Separate signal from noise, slow key decisions down, and structure thoughts before you speak.
videos.takeaway: Clarity beats raw intelligence — structure your thinking first.

videos.title: How To Detach So Fast It Actually Scares People
videos.summary: The skill of emotional detachment: responding instead of reacting, loosening your grip on outcomes, and keeping a clear head when the stakes and emotions run high.
videos.takeaway: Detachment is power — respond, don't react.

videos.title: Watch This for 13 Minutes and You'll Outperform 99% of People
videos.summary: The small set of skills and habits — amplified by AI — that separate top performers from everyone else. Outperformance is a few compounding edges, not one heroic move.
videos.takeaway: Stack a few compounding edges instead of chasing one big win.

videos.title: Give Me 3 Minutes and I'll Save You 10 Years of Suffering
videos.summary: Hard-won life lessons compressed into a few principles designed to spare you years of wasted effort and avoidable pain. Much suffering comes from delaying decisions you already know you must make.
videos.takeaway: Most suffering is a delayed decision in disguise.

videos.title: Want To Be Rich? Don't Start A Business... Do THIS
videos.summary: Why starting a business isn't the only — or best — path to wealth, and the higher-leverage alternatives most people overlook before taking on founder-level risk.
videos.takeaway: Choose leverage over ownership of unnecessary risk.

videos.title: Communicate With Confidence: The Blueprint For Mastering Every Conversation
videos.summary: A blueprint for confident conversation: managing nerves, framing ideas crisply, listening for what actually matters, and projecting calm authority in any room.
videos.takeaway: Confidence is a set of repeatable habits, not a personality trait.

videos.title: Why You're Working Hard But Still Falling Behind (Master These Skills)
videos.summary: The hidden reason effort doesn't translate into results, and the high-leverage skills that actually move the needle. Reframes the difference between being busy and being effective.
videos.takeaway: Master leverage, not hustle.

videos.title: How Living a Slow and Boring Life Made Me a Millionaire
videos.summary: The counterintuitive case for a calm, consistent, low-drama life as the real engine of wealth — and how avoiding noise lets compounding do the heavy lifting.
videos.takeaway: Boring consistency compounds into wealth.

videos.title: These 7 Tiny Habits Will Transform Your Life
videos.summary: Seven small, sustainable habits that compound into outsized changes in focus, energy and results — chosen because they're easy to keep, not impressive to announce.
videos.takeaway: Tiny sustainable habits beat big resolutions.

videos.title: Money Principles I Know Today But Wish I Knew in My 20s
videos.summary: Timeless personal-finance principles — on compounding, spending discipline, and building wealth — that the speaker learned the hard way and wishes he'd applied a decade earlier.
videos.takeaway: Time in the game beats timing the game.

videos.title: 9 Simple Steps to Actually Make Money in 2025
videos.summary: A practical 9-step path to start actually earning: find real demand, package your skills into an offer, and build income without overcomplicating the process.
videos.takeaway: Money follows solved problems — start there.

videos.title: From Homeless to MIT Grad: How I Started from $0 and Created Billions
videos.summary: Sandeep's personal arc from homelessness and monkhood to MIT and building billions in enterprise value — with lessons on product-market fit, resilience, and starting from absolute zero.
videos.takeaway: Your starting point doesn't cap your trajectory.
